categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of non-contact machine vision inspection and measurement systems, including automated optical inspection (AOI) equipment. Its product lines cover PCB drilling and forming process measurement, PCB and COF line inspection, HDI and IC substrate inspection, semiconductor packaging inspection, and electrical testing equipment. The company also engages in related import and export trade activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include optical imaging systems, image processing, AI deep learning, precision mechanics, motion control, and smart camera edge computing. The company develops 2D/3D measurement, line inspection (AOI), and appearance inspection (AVI) technologies, integrating AI to reduce false positives and labor. Production involves modular assembly of mechanical, electrical, optical, and software components, with rigorous quality control and testing procedures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are PCB manufacturers, semiconductor packaging and testing companies, and COF (Chip on Film) industries. The company serves leading global PCB manufacturers, including top 100 PCB firms worldwide, and semiconductor firms in Taiwan, China, Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the US. End markets include electronics, communications, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, and advanced semiconductor packaging sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, China, Thailand, Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and the United States. It has production and service facilities in Taiwan, China (Dongguan), and Thailand, with sales and service networks covering major PCB and semiconductor manufacturing regions globally. The majority of sales revenue comes from exports, especially to China and other Asian markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment as a manufacturer and supplier of precision inspection and measurement equipment used by PCB and semiconductor manufacturers. It integrates upstream optical and electronic components and provides downstream inspection solutions to end manufacturers, positioning itself as a key equipment supplier in the semiconductor and PCB production supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic focus includes advancing AOI technologies with higher precision and speed, integrating 2D/3D measurement and AI deep learning for enhanced inspection accuracy. The company invests heavily in R&D to develop new products such as high-precision four-wire electrical testers and six-sided IC package inspection machines. It pursues vertical and horizontal integration through strategic alliances, expanding into semiconductor packaging and advanced packaging AOI equipment, and aims to provide comprehensive Industry 4.0 smart inspection solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of inspection and measurement equipment. The company also earns service income from equipment maintenance and support. It engages in international trade activities related to its products. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue models; the focus is on direct sales and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic supplier with a strong market position, serving over 90% of the top 100 global PCB manufacturers. Major competitors in line AOI inspection include international firms such as KLA, CIMS (formerly Camtek PCB division), and Screen. For appearance inspection, competitors include Japanese firms like Shirai and domestic developers like Tianxin Technology. The company differentiates itself through rapid R&D, AI integration, modular product lines, and strong customer service.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.53 billion, a 13% decrease from the previous year, with net profit after tax of about NT$316 million, down 23%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with total assets around NT$5.78 billion and equity of about NT$5.09 billion. R&D investment is significant, accounting for over 16% of revenue in 2023, reflecting a growth-oriented profile despite recent revenue declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive one-stop solution for optical inspection equipment, uniquely combining line AOI, appearance AVI, and 2D/3D measurement technologies. Its products feature high precision, modular design, and AI-powered defect detection, enabling customers to reduce labor costs and improve yield. Strong local and regional service support, rapid product development cycles, and extensive patent protection further differentiate the company in a competitive market.
